summary: Accenture Capital Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered public offering of multiple series of senior notes (floating rate and fixed rate), fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Accenture plc. The filing is a routine debt takedown under an existing shelf registration statement, not a special situation. Exact terms (aggregate principal amounts, interest rates, maturity dates) are left blank as preliminary. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The offering is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
